title: Filipino Frittata with Golden Eggs
description: A gluten-free Filipino-inspired frittata recipe with golden eggs.

ingredients.name: Filipino eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs for a rich frittata

ingredients.name: Frittata seasoning
ingredients.notes: Filipino-style spices for a unique twist

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for a balanced flavor

instructions: 2. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
3. Add sliced onions and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
4. Add diced bell peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
5. In a large bowl, whisk eggs and frittata seasoning.
6. Pour egg mixture over the skillet contents and cook until edges start to set.
7. Transfer skillet to preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the frittata is set.
8. Remove from oven and garnish with chopped cilantro.
